_instructions: HOW TO ADD AN ITEM: copy an existing item of the same type in Catalogue Items and edit it. Every item needs an Updated month (YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-09), shown on the card as 'Updated: Sep, 2026'; set it to the month the visual or data was last refreshed. Every item also needs a Mode of exactly static or interactive, shown as the corner badge on the thumbnail. Use interactive for embeds and anything a viewer can click or explore (Tableau, Power BI, custom HTML, maps, dashboards) and static for images, charts and plain datasets. If Mode is missing or anything else, no badge is shown. HD GRAPHIC: export your PowerPoint or Canva slide as a PNG or JPG (File > Export > Image, highest quality), upload it through the Image field, set the type to image, and fill in title, description and sector. It appears in the gallery and opens full-size when clicked. DASHBOARD: for Power BI, choose File > Embed report > Publish to web (or use your organisation's secure embed link) and copy the embed URL. Paste it into Embed URL on an item of type dashboard. The same works for Tableau Public, Looker Studio or any tool that gives you an embeddable link. CHART (no design tool needed): set the type to chart and choose bar, line or pie. Add your categories under Chart Labels and your numbers under Chart Series; each series must have the same number of values as there are labels. No image needed, the chart draws itself. Use bar to compare a few categories, line for change over time, and pie for shares of one whole. Optional: Unit Suffix (e.g. % or kg), Value Prefix (e.g. $), axis titles, and Sort Descending to rank bars biggest first. ARTICLE: set the type to article, fill in title, excerpt and sector, and set Link to a page on this site (e.g. an Updates post) or an external report URL.

Optional data fields:
• "unit" (suffix): "%" attaches with no space, any other text gets one space (e.g. "kg" gives "12 kg").
• "prefix" (attached as written, so "$" gives "$3.83" and "MWK " gives "MWK 127,764").

Examples:
• formatValue(58,{unit:"%"}) gives "58%"
• formatValue(3.83,{prefix:"$"}) gives "$3.83"
• formatValue(12,{unit:"kg"}) gives "12 kg"
• formatValue(127764,{prefix:"MWK "}) gives "MWK 127,764"
• formatValue(1.65,{prefix:"$"}) gives "$1.65"
• formatValue(0.5,{prefix:"$"}) gives "$0.5"

items.title: Tobacco revenue dropped by 39% in 2026 compared to 2025
items.description:
Tobacco remains Malawi’s main export and a key source of foreign exchange. However, the 2026 selling season saw export earnings fall from US$380.56 million in 2025 to US$233.32 million.

The decline reflects both lower sales volumes and lower average prices per kilogram. With tobacco bringing in less foreign exchange, pressure on the country’s ability to import essential goods, including fuel, has increased.
